# bitbucket Provider

Manages Bitbucket Cloud projects, repositories, branch restrictions, Pipelines configuration (pipeline config, variables, runners) and deployment environments.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    bitbucket = {
      source  = "registry.terraform.io/JCardenasVGx/bitbucket"
      version = "~> 1.0"
    }
  }
}

# workspace, username and password can also be set via the BITBUCKET_WORKSPACE,
# BITBUCKET_USERNAME and BITBUCKET_PASSWORD environment variables instead of
# hardcoding them here.
provider "bitbucket" {
  workspace = "mi-workspace"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `password` (String, Sensitive) Bitbucket app password or API token. Can also be set via BITBUCKET_PASSWORD.
- `username` (String) Bitbucket username (or Atlassian account email when using an API token). Can also be set via BITBUCKET_USERNAME.
- `workspace` (String) Bitbucket Cloud workspace slug. Can also be set via the BITBUCKET_WORKSPACE environment variable.
